cashback_bonus_cap.note: S$ | With >S$1,600 spend per calendar month, cashback capped at S$180 per month across 5 selected Preferred Categories (S$30 per Preferred Category + S$30 for all other spend). Between S$800 to S$1,600 monthly spend, cashback capped at S$120 per month (S$20 per Preferred Category + S$20 for all other spend).

rewards_bonus_cap.note: S$ | Cashback capped at S$125 per calendar month (S$25 per selected category).

highlights: Up to 8% cashback on 5 Preferred selected spend Categories (Choose from 10 available cashback categories - Automotive, Beauty & Wellness, Commute, Dining & Food Delivery, Entertainment, Groceries, Kids & Pets, Online Shopping, Sports & Sports Apparels and Telco & Streaming). Earn unlimited 0.22% cashback on other eligible spend. Cashback is capped at up to S$180 monthly for local and overseas purchases for the Preferred Categories, as well as Malaysian Ringgit and Indonesia Rupiah transactions.
pros: Earn up to 8% cashback for 5 Preferred Categories across 10 options.
pros: Get up to 8% cashback on Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) and Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) spend.
pros: Earn up to S$180 cashback every month.
pros: Preferred Categories can be changed trimonthly or every 3 months.
pros: No annual fee for supplementary card.
cons: Monthly cashback at 0.22% for spends below S$800.

extra.description: Enjoy the freedom to pick your bonus cashback category, to earn up to 8% cashback when you spend with the Maybank Family & Friends Card.
